question: In fiscal 2024, what percentage of Cloudflare's (NYSE: NET) revenue was derived from channel partners?
answer: 20% of revenue was derived from channel partners

rubric.criteria: 20% of revenue was derived from channel partners

20% revenue from channel partners in fiscal 2024

model_answer:
In fiscal 2024, about **20%** of Cloudflare's revenue came from channel partners. That is roughly $337.4 million of about $1.67 billion in total revenue. Direct customers made up the other 80%.

The figures come from the revenue note in Cloudflare's FY2024 Form 10-K. The channel-partner share has risen over time, from 13% in 2022 to 16% in 2023 and 20% in 2024.
